source: Analyst-curated disease/symptom/clinical procedure/anatomy terms present in the selected references, fixed before ASR results; not an authoritative medical ontology. Common conversational words excluded.
normalization: Same lowercase and punctuation-ignore intent as tests/dictation_first_site_passage.py:words. Literal [a-z]+ deletes Korean and cannot yield Korean CER/WER. Use NFC, lowercase, Unicode letter/number runs (punctuation acts as word separator); keep lexical variants/numbers as labelled. No spelling correction, synonym or phonetic matching.
CER: Levenshtein Unicode code-point distance on concatenated normalized tokens / reference characters; Hangul syllables, excluding whitespace.
WER: Levenshtein distance on normalized whitespace-delimited Korean eojeol tokens / reference tokens. Sensitive to label spacing.
medical_term_recall: On whitespace-free normalized strings, match a longest-first alternation of the frozen terms without overlap. Per utterance and term, hits=min(reference occurrences, hypothesis occurrences); sum hits / reference occurrences. No synonym credit. This is exact substring recall, not negation, clinical correctness or precision.
acceptance: No numeric quality threshold was supplied; report measurements, not PASS for first-site acceptance.
literal_synthetic_normalization: Also report [a-z]+ reference/hypothesis counts; when reference count is zero rate is undefined (not zero error).
